patterns: APPSC asks Kakatiya terms as direct single facts: Motupalli = Desiyakonda Pattanam, Ayagars = 12, Kayastha = scribes, Pradvivaka = judicial adviser, Samaya, Chitrameli.
Tank-builder pairs are APPSC favourites: Kesari Samudram = Rudradeva, Arikesari = Prola II, Govardhana Samudram = Surambika.
APPSC asks social interpretation: non-Brahmanisation of religion and politics culminated under the Kakatiyas.
Nayankara system introduced by Prataparudra II (APPSC 2025); Abhaya Sasanam 1244 = Ganapatideva.
App uses many statement/match items on tax and guild terms; consistent with APPSC's AP-history depth, slightly more elaborate.
